title: A Great Honour and Privilege: Joining The Worshipful Company of Butchers
excerpt: I am delighted and honoured to share that I have been accepted as a member of The Worshipful Company of Butchers in London.
content:
I am delighted and honoured to share that I have been accepted as a member of The Worshipful Company of Butchers in London.

Joining such a historic institution, with centuries of tradition and a strong connection to the meat and food industry, is a great privilege for me both personally and professionally.

I would like to express my sincere thanks to everyone who has supported and encouraged me throughout this process, especially Paul, Miles and Carla, for their kindness, guidance and assistance.

I look forward to becoming part of this distinguished community, contributing to its traditions and values, and building new relationships with fellow members.

A very special moment and a great honour.

Thank you, The Worshipful Company of Butchers, for this opportunity.
